reference: FINDING: The Battle of White Plains was fought on October 28, 1776 near White Plains, New York, as part of the New York and New Jersey campaign in the American Revolutionary War. British General William Howe aimed to cut off George Washington's escape route after the Continental Army's retreat from New York City. Despite establishing a position in White Plains, Washington's troops were driven from a nearby hill by Howe's forces, leading to a retreat farther north.
